usage.title: Usage
usage.lead: How often dashboards are opened and how often, how fast and how reliably panels and data sources answer.
usage.privacy: Counted per dashboard, panel and data source only, never per person: Kalzit stores no users, sessions or addresses for it.
usage.recordingOff: Recording is off; new views and queries are not counted.
usage.since: Recorded since {date}; nothing is known before.
usage.dropped: {count} events were not counted since the server started, because too many were waiting at once.
usage.totals.title: Totals of the period
usage.trend.title: Trend
usage.dashboards.title: Most viewed dashboards
usage.dashboards.lead: How often each dashboard was opened in the period.
usage.dashboards.none: No dashboard was opened in the period.
usage.slowPanels.title: Slowest panels
usage.slowPanels.lead: By the time 95 of 100 runs of a panel stay within (p95), with the median.
usage.slowPanels.none: No panel ran in the period.
usage.failingPanels.title: Panels with errors
usage.failingPanels.lead: Panels whose queries failed, by the share of failed runs.
usage.failingPanels.none: No panel failed in the period.
usage.sources.title: Data sources
usage.sources.lead: Every query per data source, also from Explore, variables, live updates and exports. Durations leave out answers from the query cache.
usage.sources.none: No data source was queried in the period.
usage.unused.title: Unused dashboards
usage.unused.lead: Dashboards nobody opened in the chosen time.
usage.unused.none: Every dashboard was opened in the last {days} days.
